title: Nonvanishing of the real-valued function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The real-valued function obtained by viewing each output sign as a real number is not the zero function; equivalently, its value is nonzero at every input.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
